articles.impact: Replaces definitions in regulation article 3(1)(a),(i),(p): payable unit-price range, internal reference group including equivalent groups, drug market ratio.
Regulation article 5: Medula data wording and authority to establish internal-reference/equivalent groups.
Committee representation under article 8 adds Ilac, Eczacilik, Saglik Bilim ve Teknolojileri Vakfi and changes 4 to 5.
Article 9: Medula data, internal-reference/equivalent-group opinions and payable-unit-price terminology.

Article 12 application/list/market mechanism changes. New cheapest-unit-price drugs excluded from price-band calculation until reaching 1% market ratio, checked monthly. Cheapest drugs that did not reach 1% in any of last five months removed from calculation and re-included when monthly ratio reaches 1%. Distribution-document requirement and Current Market Status terminology also changed.
